title: Prime Minister congratulates Neeru Dhanda on winning historic Gold in Women’s Trap at Asian Games
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has congratulated Neeru Dhanda on becoming the first Indian woman to win an individual Gold medal in the Trap event at the Asian Games. The Prime Minister lauded her exceptional accuracy and composure and said that her achievement has brought immense pride to the nation. Shri Modi expressed confidence that the historic feat would inspire many more young sportspersons to take up shooting and strive for the highest honours. The Prime Minister’s Office wrote on X; “Neeru Dhanda has given India a historic moment to celebrate! Congratulations to her on becoming the first Indian woman to win an individual Gold in Trap at the Asian Games. Her exceptional accuracy and composure have brought immense pride to the nation. This achievement will encourage many more young sportspersons to take up shooting and aim for the highest honours: PM @narendramodi” Neeru Dhanda has given India a historic moment to celebrate!

Congratulations to her on becoming the first Indian woman to win an individual Gold in Trap at the Asian Games.

Her exceptional accuracy and composure have brought immense pride to the nation.
